about.eyebrow: A little about how I work
about.title: A practical mix of organization, creativity, and technical awareness.
paragraphs: I’m Eloisa Jane, a BSIT graduate with a background in web development, graphic design, and digital projects. I combine technical knowledge, creativity, and organization to help businesses keep tasks organized, present their brand professionally, and maintain a smoother digital workflow.

From organizing information and creating visual content to updating websites and troubleshooting issues, I focus on practical solutions that save time, reduce friction, and help businesses run more efficiently.
I value clear communication, attention to detail, and delivering work that makes a meaningful difference.
